<thought>The retrieved template (ID 12345) does not match the target molecule and cannot be applied, indicating it is the wrong template for the TBS deprotection. To obtain the correct retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog for reactions that break a Si‑O bond (the TBS protecting group) and form an aliphatic hydroxyl group. This should return the appropriate template(s) that can be applied to the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["Si-O"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["hydroxyl"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
